1.en: By the sky and the night comer -

2.en: And what can make you know what is the night comer?

4.ar: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
4.en: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

5.en: So let man observe from what he was created.

6.en: He was created from a fluid, ejected,

7.en: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

8.en: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.

9.en: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

10.ar: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
10.en: Then man will have no power or any helper.

12.en: And [by] the earth which cracks open,

13.en: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,

15.en: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

16.en: But I am planning a plan.

17.en: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
